dn26:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Magadhesu viharati Mātulāyaṃ.
dn26:1.7: ‘Atta-dīpā bhikkhave viharatha atta-saraṇā anaññasaraṇā, dhamma-dīpā dhamma-saraṇā anañña-saraṇā.
dn26:1.8: ‘Kathañ ca pana bhikkhave bhikkhu atta-dīpo viharati atta-saraṇo anañña-saraṇo, dhamma-dīpo dhamma-saraṇo anañña-saraṇo?
dn26:1.9: ‘Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ,
dn26:1.12: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ.
dn26:1.13: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu atta-dīpo viharati atta-saraṇo anañña-saraṇo, dhammadīpo dhamma-saraṇo anañña-saraṇo.
dn26:1.15: Gocare bhikkhave carataṃ sake pettike visaye na lacchati Māro otāraṃ , na lacchati Māro ārammaṇaṃ.
dn26:1.16: Kusalānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ samādāna-hetu evam idaṃ puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatīti.' 2.
dn26:2.1: Bhūta-pubbaṃ bhikkhave rājā Daḷhanemi nāma ahosi cakkavatti dhammiko dhamma-rājā cātur-anto vijitāvī janapada-tthāvariya-ppatto satta-ratana-samannāgato.
dn26:2.2: Tass' imāni satta ratanāni ahesuṃ, seyyathīdaṃ
dn26:2.3: cakkaratanaṃ, hatthi-ratanaṃ, assa-ratanaṃ, maṇi-ratanaṃ, itthi-ratanaṃ, gahapati-ratanaṃ, pariṇāyaka-ratanam eva sattamaṃ.
dn26:2.4: Paro- sahassaṃ kho pan' assa puttā ahesuṃ sūrā vīraṅga-rūpā parasena-ppamaddanā.
dn26:2.5: So imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgara-pariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasi. 3.
dn26:3.1: Atha kho bhikkhave rājā Daḷhanemi bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassa-satānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassa-sahassānaṃ accayena aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi:
dn26:3.2: ‘Yadā tvaṃ ambho purisa passeyyāsi dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ osakkitaṃ ṭhānā cutaṃ, atha me āroceyyāsīti.'
dn26:3.3: ‘Evaṃ devāti' kho bhikkhave so puriso rañño Daḷhanemikassa paccassosi.
dn26:3.4: ‘Addasā kho bhikkhave so puriso bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassa-satānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassa-sahassānaṃ accayena dibbaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ osakkitaṃ ṭhānā cutaṃ. Disvā yena rājā Daḷhanemi ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā rājānaṃ Daḷhanemiṃ etad avoca:
dn26:3.5: ‘Yagghe deva jāneyyāsi dibbaṃ te cakka-ratanaṃ osakkitaṃ ṭhānā cutan ti?'
dn26:3.6: Atha kho bhikkhave rājā Daḷhanemi jeṭṭha-puttaṃ kumāraṃ āmantāpetvā etad avoca:
dn26:3.7: ‘Dibbaṃ kira me tāta kumāra cakka-ratanaṃ osakkitaṃ ṭhānā cutaṃ.
dn26:3.9: "Yassa rañño cakkavattissa dibbaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ osakkati ṭhānā cavati; na dāni tena raññā ciraṃ jīvitabbaṃ hotīti."
dn26:3.10: Bhuttā kho pana me mānusakā kāmā, samayo dibbe kāme pariyesituṃ.
dn26:3.11: Ehi tvaṃ tāta kumāra imaṃ samudda-pariyantaṃ paṭhaviṃ paṭipajja.
dn26:3.12: Ahaṃ pana kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā, kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmīti.'
dn26:3.13: Atha kho bhikkhave rājā Daḷhanemi jeṭṭha-puttaṃ kumāraṃ sādhukaṃ rajje samanusāsitvā, kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā, kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā , agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji.
dn26:3.14: Sattāha-pabbajite kho pana bhikkhave rājisimhi dibbaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ antaradhāyi. 4.
dn26:4.1: Atha kho bhikkhave aññataro puriso yena rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā rājānaṃ khattiyaṃ muddhāvasittaṃ etad avoca:
dn26:4.2: ‘Yagghe deva jāneyyāsi dibbaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ antarahitan ti?'
dn26:4.3: Atha kho bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto dibbe cakka-ratane antarahite anattamano ahosi, anattamanatañ ca paṭisaṃvedesi.
dn26:4.4: So yena ca rājisi ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā rājisiṃ etad avoca:
dn26:4.5: ‘Yagghe deva jāneyyāsi dibbaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ antarahitan ti?'
dn26:4.6: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave rājisi rājānaṃ khattiyaṃ muddhāvasittaṃ etad avoca:
dn26:4.7: ‘Mā kho tvaṃ tāta dibbe cakka-ratane antarahite anattamano ahosi anattamanatañ ca paṭisaṃvedesi. Na hi te tāta dibbaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ pettikaṃ dāyajjaṃ.
dn26:4.8: Iṅgha tvaṃ tāta ariye cakkavatti-vatte vattāhi.
dn26:4.9: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati yan te ariye cakkavatti-vatte vattamānassa tadahu 'posathe paṇṇarase sīsaṃ nahātassa uposathikassa upari-pāsāda-vara-gatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pātu bhavissati sahassāraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāra-paripūran ti.' 5.
dn26:5.1: ‘Katamaṃ pan' etaṃ deva ariyaṃ cakkavatti-vattan ti?'
dn26:5.2: ‘Tena hi tvaṃ tāta dhammaṃ yeva nissāya dhammaṃ sakkaronto dhammaṃ garukaronto dhammaṃ mānento dhammaṃ pūjento dhammaṃ apacāyamāno, dhammaddhajo dhamma-ketu dhammādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkhāvaraṇa-guttiṃ saṃvidahassu anto-janasmiṃ bala-kāyasmiṃ khattiyesu anuyuttesu brāhmaṇa-gahapatikesu negama-jānapadesu Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇesu miga-pakkhīsu.
dn26:5.3: Mā ca te tāta vijite adhamma-kāro pavattittha.
dn26:5.4: Ye ca te tāta vijite adhanā assu, tesañ ca dhanam anuppadajjeyyāsi.
dn26:5.5: Ye ca te tāta vijite Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā mada-ppamādā paṭiviratā khanti-soracce niviṭṭhā ekam attānaṃ damenti, ekam attānaṃ samenti, ekam attānam parinibbāpenti, te kālena kālaṃ upasaṃkamitvā paripuccheyyāsi --
dn26:5.6: "Kiṃ bhante kusalaṃ kiṃ akusalaṃ, kiṃ sāvajjam kiṃ anavajjaṃ. kiṃ sevitabbaṃ kiṃ na sevitabbaṃ, kiṃ me kayiramānaṃ dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya assa, kiṃ vā pana me kayiramānaṃ dīgha-rattaṃ hitāya sukhāya assāti?"
dn26:5.7: Tesaṃ sutvā yaṃ akusalaṃ taṃ abhinivajjeyyāsi, yaṃ kusalaṃ taṃ samādāya vatteyyāsi.
dn26:5.8: Idaṃ kho tāta taṃ ariyaṃ cakkavatti-vattan ti.'
dn26:5.10: ‘Evaṃ devāti' kho bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto rājisissa paṭissutvā ariye cakkavatti-vatte vatti.
dn26:5.11: Tassa ariye cakkavatti-vatte vattamānassa tadahu 'posathe paṇṇarase sīsaṃ nahātassa uposathikassa upari-pāsāda-varagatassa
dn26:5.12: dibbaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ pātur ahosi sahassāraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāra-paripūraṃ.
dn26:5.13: Disvā rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa etad ahosi:
dn26:5.14: ‘Sutaṃ kho pana me taṃ -- "Yassa rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa tadahu 'posathe paṇṇarase sīsaṃ nahātassa uposathikassa upari-pāsāda-vara-gatassa dibbaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ pātu bhavati sahassāraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāra-paripūraṃ, so hoti cakkavattīti."
dn26:5.15: Assaṃ nu kho ahaṃ rājā cakkavattīti.' 6.
dn26:6.1: Atha kho bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto uṭṭhāy' āsanā, ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā, vāmena hatthena bhiṃkāraṃ gahetvā, dakkhiṇena hatthena cakkaratanaṃ abbhukkiri:
dn26:6.2: ‘Pavattatu bhavaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ, abhivijinātu bhavaṃ cakka-ratanan ti.'
dn26:6.3: Atha kho taṃ bhikkhave cakka-ratanaṃ puratthimaṃ disaṃ pavatti, anvad eva rājā cakkavatti saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya. Yasmiṃ kho pana bhikkhave padese cakka-ratanaṃ patiṭṭhāsi, tattha rājā cakkavatti vāsaṃ upagacchi saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya.
dn26:6.4: Ye kho pana bhikkhave puratthimāya disāya paṭirājāno, te rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upasaṃkamitvā evam āhaṃsu:
dn26:6.5: ‘Ehi kho Mahārāja, sāgataṃ Mahārāja, sakan te Mahārāja, anusāsa Mahārājāti.'
dn26:6.7: ‘Pāṇo na hantabbo. Adinnaṃ n' ādātabbaṃ. Kāmesu micchā na caritabbā. Musā na bhāsitabbā. Majjaṃ na pātabbaṃ. Yathā-bhuttañ ca bhuñjathāti.'
dn26:6.8: Ye kho pana bhikkhave puratthimāya disāya paṭirājāno, te rañño cakkavattissa anuyuttā ahesuṃ. 7.
dn26:7.1: Atha kho taṃ bhikkhave cakka-ratanaṃ puratthimaṃ samuddaṃ ajjhogahetvā paccuttaritvā dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ pavatti . . . pe . . . anuyuttā ahesuṃ. Atha kho taṃ bhikkhave cakka-ratanaṃ
dn26:7.2: dakkhiṇaṃ samuddaṃ ajjhogahetvā paccuttāritvā pacchimaṃ disaṃ pavatti . . . pe . . .
dn26:7.9: Atha kho taṃ bhikkhave cakka-ratanaṃ pacchimaṃ samuddaṃ ajjhogahetvā paccuttaritvā uttaraṃ disaṃ pavatti, anvad eva rājā cakkavatti saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya.
dn26:7.10: Yasmiṃ kho pana bhikkhave padese cakkaratanaṃ patiṭṭhāsi , tattha rājā cakkavatti vāsaṃ upagacchi saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya.
dn26:7.11: Ye kho pana bhikkhave uttarāya disāya paṭirājāno, te rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upasaṃkamitvā evam āhaṃsu:
dn26:7.12: ‘Ehi kho Mahārāja, sāgataṃ Mahārāja, sakan te Mahārāja, anusāsa Mahārājāti.'
dn26:7.14: ‘Pāṇo na hantabbho. Adinnaṃ n' ādātabbaṃ. Kāmesu micchā na caritabbā. Musā na bhāsitabbā. Majjaṃ na pātabbaṃ. Yathā-bhuttañ ca bhuñjathāti.'
dn26:7.15: Ye kho pana bhikkhave uttarāya disāya paṭirājāno, te rañño cakkavattissa anuyuttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:7.16: Atha kho taṃ bhikkhave cakka-ratanaṃ samudda-pariyantaṃ paṭhaviṃ abhivijinitvā tam eva rājadhāniṃ paccāgantvā rañño cakkavattissa antepura-dvāre attha-karaṇapamukhe akkhāhataṃ maññe aṭṭhāsi rañño cakkavattissa antepuraṃ upasobhayamānaṃ. 8.
dn26:8.1: Dutiyo pi kho bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti . . .
dn26:8.2: Tatiyo pi kho bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti. . . .
dn26:8.3: Catuttho pi kho bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti. . . .
dn26:8.4: Pañcamo pi kho bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti. . . .
dn26:8.5: Chaṭṭho pi kho bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti. . . .
dn26:8.6: Sattamo pi kho bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassa-satānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassa-sahassānaṃ accayena aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi:
dn26:8.7: ‘Yadā kho tvaṃ ambho purisa passeyyāsi dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ osakkitaṃ ṭhānā cutaṃ, atha me āroceyyāsīti.'
dn26:8.8: ‘Evaṃ devāti' kho bhikkhave so puriso rañño cakkavattissa paccassosi.
dn26:8.9: Addasā kho bhikkhave so puriso bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassa-satānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassa-sahassānaṃ accayena dibbaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ osakkitaṃ ṭhānā cutaṃ.
dn26:8.10: Disvā yena rājā cakkavatti ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ etad avoca:
dn26:8.11: ‘Yagghe deva jāneyyāsi dibban te cakka-ratanaṃ osakkitaṃ ṭhānā cutan ti?'
dn26:8.12: Atha kho bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti jeṭṭha-puttaṃ kumāraṃ āmantāpetvā etad avoca:
dn26:8.13: ‘Dibbaṃ kira me tāta kumāra cakka-ratanaṃ osakkitaṃ thānā cutaṃ. Sutaṃ kho pana me taṃ --
dn26:8.14: "Yassa rañño cakkavattissa dibbaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ osakkati ṭhānā cavati, na dāni tena raññā ciraṃ jīvitabbaṃ hotīti."
dn26:8.15: Bhuttā kho pana me mānusakā kāmā, samayo dibbe kāme pariyesituṃ. Ehi tvaṃ tāta kumāra, imaṃ samudda-pariyantaṃ paṭhaviṃ paṭipajja.
dn26:8.16: Ahaṃ pana kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā, kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmīti.'
dn26:8.17: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti jeṭṭha-puttaṃ kumāraṃ sādhukaṃ rajje samanusāsitvā, kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā, kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji.
dn26:8.18: Sattāha-pabbajite kho pana bhikkhave rājisimhi dibbaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ antaradhāyi. 9.
dn26:9.1: Atha kho bhikkhave aññataro puriso yena rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā rājānaṃ khattiyaṃ muddhāvasittaṃ etad avoca:
dn26:9.2: ‘Yagghe deva jāneyyāsi dibbaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ antarahitan ti?'
dn26:9.3: Atha kho bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto dibbe cakka-ratane antarahite anattamano ahosi, anattamanatañ ca paṭisaṃvedesi,
dn26:9.4: no ca kho rājisiṃ upasaṃkamitvā ariyaṃ cakkavatti-vattaṃ pucchi.
dn26:9.5: So samaten' eva sudaṃ janapadaṃ pasāsati,
dn26:9.6: tassa samatena janapadaṃ pasāsato na pubbe nāparaṃ janapadā pabbanti yathā taṃ pubbakānaṃ rājūnaṃ ariye cakkavatti-vatte vattamānānaṃ.
dn26:9.7: Atha kho bhikkhave amaccā pārisajjā gaṇaka-mahāmattā anīkaṭṭhā dovārikā mantass' ājīvino sannipatitvā rājānaṃ khattiyaṃ muddhāvasittaṃ upasaṃkamitvā etad avocuṃ:
dn26:9.8: ‘Na kho te deva samatena janapadaṃ pasāsato pubbe nāparaṃ janapadā pabbanti yathā taṃ pubbakānaṃ rājūnaṃ ariye cakkavatti-vatte vattamānāmaṃ.
dn26:9.9: Saṃvijjanti kho te deva vijite amaccā pārisajjā gaṇaka-mahāmatta anīkaṭṭhā dovārikā mantass' ājīvino, mayañ c' eva aññe ca ye mayaṃ ariyaṃ cakkavatti-vattaṃ dhārema,
dn26:9.10: iṅgha tvaṃ deva amhe ariyaṃ cakkavatti-vattaṃ puccha,
dn26:9.11: tassa te mayaṃ ariyaṃ cakkavatti-vattaṃ puṭṭhā vyākarissāmāti.' 10.
dn26:10.1: Atha kho bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto amacce pārisajje gaṇaka-mahāmatte anīkaṭṭhe dovārike mantass' ājīvino sannipātāpetvā ariyaṃ cakkavatti-vattaṃ pucchi.
dn26:10.2: Tassa te ariyaṃ cakkavatti-vattaṃ puṭṭhā vyākariṃsu.
dn26:10.3: Tesaṃ sutvā dhammikaṃ hi kho rakkhāvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahi, no ca kho adhanānaṃ dhanam anuppadāsi,
dn26:10.4: adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadiyamāne daliddiyaṃ vepullaṃ agamāsi.
dn26:10.5: Daliddiye vepulla-gate aññataro puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyi.
dn26:10.8: ‘Ayaṃ deva puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṃkhātaṃ ādiyīti.'
dn26:10.9: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto taṃ purisaṃ etad avoca:
dn26:10.10: ‘Saccaṃ kira tvaṃ ambho purisa paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyīti?'
dn26:10.14: Atha kho bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto tassa purisassa dhanam anuppadāsi --
dn26:10.15: ‘Iminā tvaṃ ambho purisa dhanena attanā ca jīvāhi, mātā-pitaro ca posehi, putta-dārañ ca posehi, kammante ca payojehi, samaṇesu brāhmaṇesu uddhaggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpehi sovaggikaṃ sukha-vipākaṃ sagga-saṃvattanikan ti.'
dn26:10.16: ‘Evaṃ devāti' kho bhikkhave so puriso rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa paccassosi. 11.
dn26:11.1: Aññataro pi kho bhikkhave puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātam ādiyi.
dn26:11.4: ‘Ayaṃ deva puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyīti.'
dn26:11.5: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto purisaṃ etad avoca:
dn26:11.6: ‘Saccaṃ kira tvaṃ ambho purisa paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyīti?'
dn26:11.10: Atha kho bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto tassa purisassa dhanam anuppadāsi --
dn26:11.11: ‘Iminā tvaṃ ambho purisa dhanena attanā ca upajīvāhi, mātā-pitaro ca posehi, puttadārañ ca posehi, kammante ca payojehi, samaṇesu brāhmaṇesu uddhaggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpehi, sovaggikaṃ sukha-vipākaṃ sagga-saṃvattanikan ti.'
dn26:11.12: ‘Evaṃ devāti' kho so bhikkhave puriso rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa paccassosi. 12.
dn26:12.2: ‘Ye kira bho paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyanti, tesaṃ rājā dhanam anuppadesīti.'
dn26:12.4: ‘Yan nūna mayam pi paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyeyyāmāti.'
dn26:12.5: Atha kho bhikkhave aññataro puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyi.
dn26:12.8: ‘Ayaṃ deva puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyīti.'
dn26:12.9: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto taṃ purisaṃ etad avoca:
dn26:12.10: ‘Saccaṃ kira tvaṃ ambho purisa paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyīti?'
dn26:12.14: Atha kho bhikkhave rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa etad ahosi:
dn26:12.15: ‘Sace kho ahaṃ yo yo paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṃkhātaṃ ādiyissati, tassa tassa dhanam anuppadāmi, evam idaṃ adinnādānaṃ pavaḍḍhissati.
dn26:12.16: Yan nūnāhaṃ imaṃ purisaṃ sunisedhaṃ nisedheyyaṃ, mūla-ghaccaṃ kareyyaṃ, sīsam assa chindeyyan ti.'
dn26:12.17: Atha kho bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto purise āṇāpesi:
dn26:12.18: ‘Tena hi bhaṇe imaṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchā-bāhaṃ gāḷha-bandhanaṃ bandhitvā, khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā, kharassarena paṇavena rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā, dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhamitvā, dakkhiṇato nagarassa sunisedhaṃ nisedhetha, mūlaghaccaṃ karotha, sīsam assa chindathāti.'
dn26:12.19: ‘Evaṃ devāti' kho bhikkhave te purisā rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa paṭissutvā taṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchā-bāhaṃ gāḷha-bandhanaṃ bandhitvā, khura-muṇḍaṃ karitvā, kharassarena paṇavena rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā, dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhamitvā, dakkhiṇato nagarassa sunisedhaṃ nisedhesuṃ, mūla-ghaccaṃ akaṃsu, sīsam assa chindiṃsu. 13.
dn26:13.2: ‘Ye kira bho paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyanti, te rājā sunisedhaṃ nisedheti, mūla-ghaccaṃ karoti, sīsāni tesaṃ chindatīti.'
dn26:13.4: ‘Yan nūna mayam pi tiṇhāni satthāni kārāpeyyāma, tiṇhāni satthāni kārāpetvā yesaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyissāma, te sunisedhaṃ nisedhessāma, mūla-ghaccaṃ karissāma, sīsāni tesaṃ chindissāmāti.'
dn26:13.5: Te tiṇhāni satthāni kārāpesuṃ, tiṇhāni satthāni kārāpetvā gāma-ghātam pi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ, nigama-ghātam pi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ, nagara-ghātam pi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ, pantha-dūhanam pi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ. Te
dn26:13.6: yesaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyanti, te sunisedhaṃ nisedhenti, mūla-ghaccaṃ karonti, sīsāni tesaṃ chindanti. 14.
dn26:14.1: Iti kho bhikkhave adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadiyamāne daliddiyaṃ vepullam agamāsi, daliddiye vepulla-gate adinnādānaṃ vepullam agamāsi, adinnādāne vepulla-gate satthaṃ vepullam agamāsi, satthe vepulla-gate pāṇātipāto vepullam agamāsi, pāṇātipāte vepulla-gate musā-vādo vepullam agamāsi, musā-vāde vepulla-gate tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi, vaṇṇo pi parihāyi;
dn26:14.2: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ asīti-vassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ cattārīsaṃ vassa-sahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:14.3: Cattārīsaṃ vassa-sahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu aññataro puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyi.
dn26:14.6: ‘Ayaṃ deva puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyīti.'
dn26:14.7: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto taṃ purisaṃ etad avoca:
dn26:14.8: ‘Saccaṃ kira tvaṃ ambho purisa paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyīti?'
dn26:15.1: Iti kho bhikkhave adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadiyamāne daliddiyaṃ vepullam agamāsi, daliddiye vepulla-gate adinnādānaṃ vāpullam agamāsi, adinnādāne vepulla-gate satthaṃ vepullam agamāsi, satthe vepulla-gate pāṇātipāto vepullam agamāsi, pāṇātipāte vepulla-gate musā-vādo vepullam agamāsi, musā-vāde vepulla-gate tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi vaṇṇo pi parihāyi,
dn26:15.2: āyunā pi parihāya mānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ cattārīsaṃ vassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vīsati-vassa-sahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:15.3: Vīsati-vassa-sahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu aññataro puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyi.
dn26:15.4: Tam enaṃ aññataro puriso rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa ārocesi:
dn26:15.5: ‘Itthannāmo deva puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyya-saṃkhātaṃ ādiyīti' pesuññam akāsi. 16.
dn26:16.1: Iti kho bhikkhave adhanānaṃ dhane na anuppadiyamāne daliddiyaṃ vepullam agamāsi, daliddiye vepullagate adinnādānaṃ vepullam agamāsi . . . pe . . . pisuṇāya vācāya vepulla-gatāya tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi vaṇṇo pi parihāyi,
dn26:16.2: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ vīsati-vassa-sahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ dasa-vassa-sahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:17.1: Dasa-vassa-sahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ek' idaṃ sattā vaṇṇavanto honti, ek' idaṃ sattā dubbaṇṇā,
dn26:17.2: tattha ye te sattā dubbaṇṇā te vaṇṇavante satte abhijjhāyantā paresaṃ dāresu cārittaṃ āpajjiṃsu. 17.
dn26:17.3: Iti kho bhikkhave adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadiyamāne daliddiyaṃ vepullam agamāsi, daliddiye vepullagate adinnādānaṃ vepullam agamāsi . . . pe . . . kāmesu micchācāro vepullam agamāsi, kāmesu micchācāre vepullagate tesaṃ sattānam āyu pi parihāyi vaṇṇo pi parihāyi,
dn26:17.4: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ dasa-vassa-sahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ pañca-vassa-sahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:17.5: Pañca-vassa-sahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu dve dhammā vepullam agamaṃsu,
dn26:17.7: dvīsu dhammesu vepulla-gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi vaṇṇo pi parihāyi,
dn26:17.8: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ pañcavassa-sahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ app ekacce aḍḍhateyya-vassa-sahassāyukā app ekacce dve vassa-sahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:17.10: vepullam agamāsi, abhijjhā-vyāpāde vepulla-gate tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi vaṇṇo pi parihāyi,
dn26:17.11: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ aḍḍhateyya-vassa-sahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vassa-sahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:17.13: vepullam agamāsi, micchā-diṭṭhiyā vepulla-gatāyā tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi vaṇṇo pi parihāyi,
dn26:17.14: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ vassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ pañca-vassa-satāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:17.15: Pañca-vassa-satāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu tayo dhammā vepullam agamaṃsu
dn26:17.17: tīsu dhammesu vepulla-gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi vaṇṇo pi parihāyī,
dn26:17.18: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ pañcavassa-satāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ app ekacce aḍḍhateyyavassa-satāyukā app ekacce dve-vassa-satāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:17.19: Aḍḍhateyya-vassa-satāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ime dhammā vepullam agamaṃsu
dn26:18.1: Iti kho bhikkhave adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadiyamāne daliddiyam vepullam agamāsi,
dn26:18.6: vepullam agamāsi, musā-vāde vepulla-gate pisuṇā vācā vepullam agamāsi,
dn26:18.8: vepullam agamāsi, kāmesu micchācāre vepulla-gate dve dhammā vepullam agamaṃsu pharusā vācā samphappalāpo ca.
dn26:18.11: diṭṭhi vepullam agamāsi, micchā-diṭṭhiyā vepulla-gatāya tayo dhammā vepullam agamaṃsu adhamma-rāgo visama-lobho micchā-dhammo,
dn26:18.12: tīsu dhammesu vepulla-gatesu ime dhammā vepullam agamaṃsu amatteyyatā apetteyyatā asāmaññatā abrahmaññatā nakule-jeṭṭhāpacāyitā,
dn26:18.13: imesu dhammesu vepulla-gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi vaṇṇo pi parihāyi,
dn26:18.14: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ aḍḍhateyya -vassa-satāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vassa-satāyukā puttā ahesuṃ. 19.
dn26:19.1: Bhavissati bhikkhave so samayo, yaṃ imesaṃ manussānaṃ dasa-vassāyukā puttā bhavissanti.
dn26:19.2: Dasa-vassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu pañca-vassikā kumārikā alam-pateyyā bhavissanti.
dn26:19.3: Dasa-vassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu imāni rasāni antaradhāyissanti, seyyathīdaṃ
dn26:19.5: Dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu kudrūsako aggaṃ bhojanānaṃ bhavissati.
dn26:19.6: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave etarahi sāli-maṃsodano aggaṃ bhojanānaṃ ,
dn26:19.7: evam eva kho bhikkhave dasa-vassāyukesu manussesu kudrūsako aggaṃ bhojanānaṃ bhavissati.
dn26:19.8: Dasa-vassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu dasa kusala-kamma-pathā sabbena sabbaṃ antaradhāyissanti, dasa akusala-kamma-pathā ativiya dippissanti,
dn26:19.9: dasa-vassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ‘Kusalan' ti pi na bhavissati. Kuto pana kusalassa kārako?
dn26:19.10: Dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ye te bhavissanti amatteyyā apetteyyā asāmaññā abrahmaññā na-kule-jeṭṭhāpacāyino, te pujjā ca bhavissanti pāsaṃsā ca.
dn26:19.11: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave etarahi matteyyā petteyyā sāmaññā brahmaññā kule-jeṭṭhāpacāyino, te pujjā ca pāsaṃsā ca,
dn26:19.12: evam eva kho bhikkhave dasa-vassāyukesu manussesu ye te bhavissanti amatteyyā apetteyyā asāmaññā abrahmaññā na-kule-jeṭṭhāpacāyino, te pujjā ca bhavissanti pāsaṃsā ca. 20.
dn26:20.1: Dasa-vassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu na bhavissati mātā ti vā mātucchā ti vā mātulānī ti vā ācāriyabhariyā ti vā garūnaṃ dārā ti vā,
dn26:20.2: sambhedaṃ loko gamissati yathā ajeḷakā kukkuṭa-sūkarā soṇa-sigālā.
dn26:20.3: Dasa-vassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ aññamaññamhi tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito bhavissati, tibbo vyāpādo, tibbo mano-padoso, tibbaṃ vadhaka-cittaṃ,
dn26:20.4: mātu pi puttamhi, puttassa pi mātari,
dn26:20.5: pitu pi puttamhi, puttassa pi pitari,
dn26:20.6: bhātu pi bhātari, bhātu pi bhaginiyā, bhaginiyā pi bhātari tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito bhavissati tibbo vyāpādo tibbo mano-padoso tibbaṃ vadhaka-cittaṃ.
dn26:20.7: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave māgavikassa migaṃ disvā tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito hoti tibbo viyāpādo tibbo mano-padoso tibbaṃ vadhaka-cittaṃ,
dn26:20.8: evam eva kho bhikkhave dasa-vassāyukesu manussesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ aññamaññamhi tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito bhavissati tibbo vyāpādo tibbo mano-padoso tibbaṃ vadhaka-cittaṃ,
dn26:20.9: mātu pi puttamhi, puttassa pi mātari,
dn26:20.10: pitu pi puttamhi, puttassa pi pitari,
dn26:20.11: bhātu pi bhātari, bhātu pi bhaginiyā, bhaginiyā pi bhātari tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito bhavissati tibbo vyāpādo tibbo manopadoso tibbaṃ vadhaka-cittaṃ. 21.
dn26:21.1: Dasa-vassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu sattāhaṃ satthantarakappo bhavissati,
dn26:21.4: te tiṇhena satthena -- ‘Esa migo esa migo ti' -- aññamaññaṃ jīvitā voropessanti.
dn26:21.5: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave sattānaṃ ekaccānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati, --
dn26:21.6: ‘Mā ca mayaṃ kañci, mā c' amhe koci, yan nūna mayaṃ tiṇagahaṇaṃ vā vana-gahaṇaṃ vā rukkha-gahaṇam vā nadīviduggaṃ vā pabbata-visamaṃ vā pavisitvā vana-mūlaphalāhārā yāpeyyāmāti.'
dn26:21.7: Te tiṇa-gahaṇaṃ vana-gahaṇaṃ rukkha-gahaṇaṃ nadī-viduggaṃ pabbata-visamaṃ pavisitvā sattāhaṃ vana-mūla-phalāhārā yāpeyyanti.
dn26:21.8: Te tassa sattāhassa accayena tiṇa-gahaṇā vana-gahaṇā rukkhagahaṇā nadī-viduggā pabbata-visamā nikkhamitvā aññamaññaṃ āliṅgitvā sabhā gāyissanti samassāsissanti
dn26:21.9: -‘Diṭṭhā bho sattā jīvasi, diṭṭhā bho sattā jīvasīti.'
dn26:21.11: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati --
dn26:21.12: ‘Mayaṃ kho akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādāna-hetu āyataṃ ñāti-kkhayaṃ pattā,
dn26:21.15: Yan nūna mayaṃ pāṇātipātā virameyyāma, idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmāti.'
dn26:21.16: Te pāṇātipātā viramissanti, idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti.
dn26:21.17: Te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādāna-hetu āyunā pi vaḍḍhissanti vaṇṇena pi vaḍḍhissanti.
dn26:21.18: Tesaṃ āyunā pi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ dasa-vassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vīsativassāyukā puttā bhavissanti. 22.
dn26:22.1: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati, --
dn26:22.2: ‘Mayaṃ kho kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādāna-hetu āyunā pi vaḍḍhāma vaṇṇena pi vaḍḍhāma,
dn26:22.3: yan nūna mayaṃ bhiyyoso-mattāya kusalaṃ kareyyāma.
dn26:22.16: yan nūna mayaṃ matteyyā assāma petteyyā sāmaññā brahmaññā kule-jeṭṭhāpacāyino, idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmāti .'
dn26:22.17: Te matteyyā bhavissanti petteyyā sāmaññā brahmaññā kule-jeṭṭhāpacāyino, idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti.
dn26:22.18: Te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādāna-hetu āyunā pi vaḍḍhissanti, vaṇṇena pi vaḍḍhissanti,
dn26:22.19: tesaṃ āyunā pi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vīsati-vassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ cattārīsa-vassāyukā puttā bhavissanti.
dn26:23.1: Vīsati-vassa-sahassā yukānaṃ manussānaṃ cattārīsaṃvassa-sahassāyukā puttā bhavissanti.
dn26:23.3: Asīti-vassa-sahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu pañca-vassa-satikā kumārikā alaṃpateyyā bhavissanti.
dn26:23.5: Asīti-vassa-sahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu tayo ābādhā bhavissanti icchā anasanaṃ jarā.
dn26:23.6: Asīti-vassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ayaṃ Jambudīpo iddho c' eva bhavissati phīto ca, kukkuṭa-sampātikā gāmanigama-rājadhāniyo.
dn26:23.7: Asīti-vassa-sahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ayaṃ Jambudīpo Avīci maññe phuṭo bhavissati manussehi seyyathā pi nala-vanaṃ vā sara-vanaṃ vā.
dn26:23.8: Asīti-vassa-sahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ayaṃ Bārāṇasī Ketumatī nāma rāja-dhānī bhavissati iddhā c' eva phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇa-manussā ca subhikkhā ca.
dn26:23.9: Asīti-vassa-sahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu imasmiṃ Jambudīpe caturāsīti-nagara-sahassāni bhavissanti Ketumatī-rājadhāni-pamukhāni. 24.
dn26:24.1: Asīti-vassa-sahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu Ketumatiyā rājadhāniyā Saṃkho nāma rājā uppajjissati cakkavatti dhammiko dhamma-rājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto satta-ratana-samannāgato.
dn26:24.2: Tass' imāni satta ratanāni bhavissanti, seyyathīdaṃ
dn26:24.3: cakka-ratanaṃ hatthi-ratanaṃ assa-ratanaṃ maṇi-ratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapati-ratanaṃ pariṇāyaka-ratanam eva sattamaṃ.
dn26:24.4: Paro- sahassaṃ kho pan' assa puttā bhavissanti sūrā vīraṅga-rūpā parasenappamaddanā.
dn26:24.5: So imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgara-pariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasissati. 25.
dn26:25.1: Asīti-vassa-sahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu Metteyyo nāma Bhagavā loke uppajjissati arahaṃ SammāSambuddho vijjā-caraṇa-sampanno sugato loka-vidū anuttaro purisa-damma-sārathi satthā deva-manussānaṃ Buddho Bhagavā,
dn26:25.2: seyyathā pi 'ham etarahi loke uppanno arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho vijjā-caraṇa-sampanno sugato loka-vidū anuttaro purisa-damma-sārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ Buddho Bhagavā.
dn26:25.3: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇa-brāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadeva-manussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedessati, seyyathā pi 'haṃ etarahi imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇa-brāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadeva-manussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedemi.
dn26:25.4: So dhammaṃ desissati ādi-kalyāṇaṃ majjhe-kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāna-kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevala-paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsessati,
dn26:25.5: seyyathā pi 'ham etarahi dhammaṃ desemi ādi-kalyāṇaṃ majjhe-kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāna-kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevala-paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
dn26:25.6: So aneka-sahassaṃ bhikkhu-saṃghaṃ pariharissati, seyyathā pi 'haṃ etarahi aneka-sataṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ pariharāmi. 26.
dn26:26.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Saṃkho nāma rājā yen' assa yūpo raññā Mahā-Panādena kārāpito,
dn26:26.2: taṃ yūpaṃ ussāpetvā ajjhāvasitvā daditvā vissajjetvā samaṇa-brāhmaṇakapaṇiddhika-vanibbaka-yācakānaṃ dānaṃ datvā Metteyyassa Bhagavato arahato Sammā-Sambuddhassa santike kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati.
dn26:26.3: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirass' eva yass' atthāya kula-puttā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyaṃ pariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati. 27.
dn26:27.1: ‘Atta-dīpā bhikkhave viharatha atta-saraṇā anaññasaraṇā, dhamma-dīpā dhamma-saraṇā anañña-saraṇā.
dn26:27.2: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu atta-dīpo viharati attasaraṇo anañña-saraṇo, dhamma-dīpo dhamma-saraṇo anañña-saraṇo?
dn26:27.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ,
dn26:27.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ.
dn26:27.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu atta-dīpo viharati atta-saraṇo anañña-saraṇo dhamma-dīpo dhamma-saraṇo anañña-saraṇo. 28.
dn26:28.2: Gocare bhikkhave carantā sake pettike visaye āyunā pi vaḍḍhissatha, vaṇṇena pi vaḍḍhissatha, sukhena pi vaḍḍhissatha, bhogena pi vaḍḍhissatha, balena pi vaḍḍhissatha.
dn26:28.8: So imesam catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā.
dn26:28.11: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, Pātimokkha-saṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāra-gocara-sampanno anumattesu vajjesu bhaya-dassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
dn26:28.14: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusaladhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pīti-sukhaṃ paṭhama-jjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
dn26:28.15: vitakka-vicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijam pīti-sukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ . . . pe . . . tatiya-jjhānaṃ . . .
dn26:28.20: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu mettā-sahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettā-sahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
dn26:28.23: sahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
dn26:28.26: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
dn26:28.28: ‘Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ eka-balam pi samanupassāmi evaṃ duppasahaṃ yathayidaṃ bhikkhave Māra-balaṃ,
dn26:28.29: kusalānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ samādāna-hetu evam idam puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatīti.'
dn26:28.31: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun ti. Cakkavatti-
